name: claude-code-mods
description: Small mods that change how Claude Code looks and sounds.

plugins.name: producer-tag
plugins.description: Plays an anime-voice producer tag (「マスター！確認してください」, 'Master! Please check this.') when Claude needs your input, or finishes work that took 10 seconds or more.

plugins.name: usage-forecast
plugins.description: A live forecast of your context window, plus your session and weekly usage limits, in the band above the prompt.

plugins.name: pixel-office
plugins.description: A pixel-art office in a pane beside your chat: you are the CEO, Claude is the Manager, and every tool call shows as a staff member doing the job.
